Sign in with Discord to share what you\'re listening to

Metrolist uses Discord\'s public OAuth2 and Gateway APIs to share what you\'re listening to. Authorization happens through a local browser session that closes itself after capturing the code — nothing is sent to third-party servers. Your token is stored on this device in encrypted preferences and is never shared. Metrolist connects directly to wss://gateway.discord.gg to publish your activity, and only requests the minimum scope required (sdk.social_layer_presence).
